verdict.rationale: Ledgy supports service-account based OAuth credentials scoped per integration with revocation, which could technically enable limited third-party access, but there is no explicit documentation of granular role/field-level scoping for external parties like law firms, HRIS vendors, or wealth managers, nor any mention of a partner/guest-access model distinct from full admin accounts. missing for 10: documented scoped roles or permission tiers for external third parties, guest/partner access UI or workflow, evidence of least-privilege data slices (e.g., read-only cap table subsets) rather than full API access via service accounts.
